summary_bullets: Guard render-final-summary.sh empty-array expansions with the Bash 3.2-safe ${ARR[@]+...} idiom.
Add a Makefile-wired Bash 3.2 regression harness that pins the static call-site idiom and dynamically exercises the empty-note_args path on vulnerable /bin/bash versions.
Register the new harness in test-harnesses-14 and agent-lint exclusions, with a sibling contract stub.
commit_message:
Fix render final summary Bash 3.2 empty-array expansion (#3039)

Guard render-final-summary.sh array expansions with the Bash 3.2-safe empty-array idiom and add a Makefile-wired regression harness for issue #3039. Register the harness in the shard and agent-lint exclusion list with a sibling contract stub.
